absences: NASA lunar fission surface power (nasa-doe-fsp-lunar): a secondary analysis (New Space Economy, 2026-09-01) says the draft SPARC solicitation's Lunar Reactor-1 requirement is 20 kWe, against the shipped 100 kWe. GovConWire returned 403 and nasa.gov/glenn/fsps returned 404, so no primary NASA text was fetched. No check written. Main session should verify against the SPARC solicitation text on NASA or SAM.gov.

Eielson AFB (eielson-pilot): the DAF microreactor page returned 403. Search summaries report a late-2028 to Q3-2030 operation shift and a Q4 2026 fuel-loading planning estimate, none fetched. The shipped record carries no operation date, so no check written.
Penn State FRONTIER (penn-state-evinci, psu-frontier): searched for a 2026 construction permit application; none found. Only the 2025-02-28 letter of intent is reported. No check written.

Oklo and Wyoming Hyperscale (oklo-wyoming-hyperscale-aspen-mountain): no 2026 update found. Coverage is 2024, and a March 2026 Wikipedia mirror still lists the letter of intent. Unverifiable, so no check written.

Last Energy London Gateway (last-energy-london-gateway): no 2026 permit, construction or financing news found. A January 2026 22 MWe grid export offer appears only in a search summary, not fetched. No check written.

Aalo RELLIS (tamu-rellis-aalo): an Aalo post dated 2025-02-04 (fetched) says a pod is 50 MW output, five Aalo-1 units per pod, with MWe or MWth unstated. The shipped 30 MWth cannot be shown outdated. The July 2026 ESP letter of intent appears only in a search summary, not fetched.
Hospitals: no microreactor power agreement with a hospital found in 2026.
Hydrogen and ammonia: 2026 deals found were electrolyzer or cracking projects, none with a microreactor. None written.
Disaster recovery: the Army-linked grid recovery model dates to 2024 and an MDPI food-manufacturing paper to 2026, neither with a named buyer or a dated utility deal. None written.

Data centers behind the meter: the GridMarket and Deployable Energy pipeline (July 2026) is already shipped as gridmarket-deployable-unb-framework. Equinix PPA figures (over 500 MW) came from one aggregator citing a 'Fictional Data' source and were not used.

Mines: the Nuclea and New Mining MOU and the Tata and BWXT trona project are already shipped. A BWXT and Wyoming Energy Authority feasibility contract (trona) was seen in a search summary only and not fetched. Yukon and Nunavut: no mine microreactor deal with a MW figure found.
Ports (DP World Constanta, WNN 2026-06-09, fetched): an SMR feasibility study with no reactor size stated. Not written, since a power number is required.
Desalination: the Natura and NGL Permian produced-water MOU (2026-02) is already shipped as ngl-natura-produced-water-2026-02-04. No new named desalination project found.
Regions (Type E): all candidate remote regions surfaced were already in skip/regions.json. No new region written.
Items (Type N): the INL and Purdue construction demonstration (announced 2026-11-05) concerns SMR construction methods with no microreactor and no MW figure. Dropped.

applications.name: Prodigy Clean Energy and Des Nëdhé Group transportable plants for remote mines
applications.vendor: Prodigy Clean Energy, with Westinghouse eVinci
applications.what_it_says: Prodigy Clean Energy and Des Nëdhé Group, an Indigenous economic development corporation, signed a memorandum of understanding to explore powering remote mines and communities in Canada. The article gives a nominal 5 MWe heat pipe reactor with 14 MWt heat capability, which Prodigy plans to integrate into its Microreactor Power Station. It names no remote-mine load, no price and no site.
applications.microreactor_read: A 5 MWe unit sits inside the 1-20 MW band, but the source is a 2024 MOU with no load, price or site, so it is not a supply contract. Prodigy has since picked BWXT's BANR, not eVinci, for its Belledune project (News, 2026-10-05), so the eVinci pairing may not be the one that ships.
